tool_input.description: Run look probe on head, sketch and hidden controls

result:
**Decision: CONTINUE.** Round 469 is the fix for Saba's "Store scroll is not smooth" bug (SABA-B-15, Medium). The task is in `current-task.md`. I changed no app code, and the store tree is still clean at `9ba13ac`.

**Round 468 accepted.** C passed all 9 rows with 0 bugs and real browser checks. Root's gate skipped the round because nothing in the store changed. The cause is now confirmed: three large decorative brass glows drawn with a CSS blur, two in `ProductSection.tsx` (l.38–39) and one in `StudioShowcase.tsx` (l.75).

**What I measured before writing the task:**
- **A's swap was too bright.** A proposed swapping each blur for a radial gradient. product-designer found the result 2.4–3.1× brighter than today's glow and set a limit of 0.8–1.3× today's strength.
- **My adjusted version passes both bounds.** I lowered only the opacity values. That version measures 1.09–1.21× today's strength.
- **Frames are fixed on the whole home page.** Slow frames drop from 8 / 5 to 0 / 0 on the standard probe and to 1 / 1 scrolling to the bottom of the page. Scrolling is still eased.
- **No other page or section needs changing here.** `/gift-cards` is already clean today, and so is the lower part of the home page once the fix is in.
- **The new guard test works.** It forbids large blur glows on the home sections and turns red on today's two files.
- **No scan test breaks.** The existing style-scan tests pass with the change (15 files, 212 tests).

**What round 469 asks:**
- **A changes exactly 4 paths:** the 3 glow lines, the new test `store-scroll-paint.test.ts`, and doc 305.
- **Nothing else may change.** Lenis, `root.tsx`, `app/styles/**`, SpecialOffers (keep-list) and Newsletter stay byte-identical.
- **C has 13 rows.** They cover:
  - a HEAD control;
  - frames on the standard probe and on the full page;
  - a "Lenis off" control that proves the eased-scroll check can fail;
  - the glows' computed style and the brightness limit;
  - edges and banding, with a product-designer review;
  - page overflow, unit tests with mutants, source scope and doc 305;
  - an anonymous auth and Studio smoke check, and the claims script.

**Things to know:**
- **SABA-B-15 does not close in round 469.** The page Saba named, `/free-downloads`, shows 0 slow frames here, and this fix doesn't touch it. Every measurement ran in the runner's software renderer, not on a GPU.
- **I wrote Saba one question,** in `user-review/questions-round-468.md`: please check `/` and `/free-downloads` on your own device after the fix is published. It also offers four scroll-feel options (keep the current feel, shorter, `lerp`-based, or off). The scroll feel won't change without his answer.
- **I changed two of product-designer's checks.** Its centre-line peak check is distorted by the product cards' backdrop blur, so C records it instead of asserting it. Its section-edge limit became "no more than today's + 1 level", because today's page itself measures 1. My reasons are in `b-round-468/pd-ruling.md`.
- **The advisor was available.** I consulted it twice, before writing and before hand-off. The second consult caught a claims check that would have failed once A added the new files; I fixed it.
- **`backlog.json` is now v465.** A's other blur observations are recorded as backlog signals, not tasks. The round-468 task is archived as `tasks/round-468.md`.
- **The 3-day regression round is due at the next planning dated 2026-11-13 or later.** After that, the order is STORE-2c and the rest of the queue.
- **Root may delete C's three round-468 scratch copies** (`c-round-468/{head,fix,mut}`), about 325 MB each.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `current-task.md`
